name: Gloamveil
respawn: 13-20 s after it falls, from its nest
behaviour: Floats five to seven metres from the hero. Every five to seven seconds it swells, marks a 6 m ring for 1.25 s, and pulses: a hit dazes the hero (40% slower for 2.8 s) and dims the screen for about three seconds; a roll dodges it all. Fragile, never shoots.
look: Glassy teal bell on a block stalk, six hanging threads and one bright core.
